widgetTool.name: acn-payee-selector
widgetTool.description: Emit a list of saved payees for the user to choose who to pay. Before calling this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase: 'Let me show you your saved payees.' Emit it whenever widgets_enabled=True, INCLUDING while you are speaking -- on a voice-enabled webchat the customer has both ears and a screen, so showing and speaking are complementary, not alternatives. Speak a short line and emit the widget. Only describe it aloud instead when widgets_enabled=False.

name.description: Required. Always output the exact string: 'acn-payee-selector'

payees.description: An array containing the list of payees.

type.description: Required. Always output the exact string: 'custom_template'
